finding.claim: The /preview endpoint fetches a URL taken straight from the query string and returns the status code and the first 500 characters of the response body. An unauthenticated caller can make the server request internal hosts, such as cloud metadata at 169.254.169.254, localhost services, or the internal status host, and read the response.
finding.source: request.args.get('url') in preview(), the `url` query parameter (app.py:15)

trace.note: @app.route('/preview') exposes the handler with no authentication
requests.get(target) is called with the full URL. Redirects are followed by default.
resp.text[:500] and the status code are returned to the caller, so the SSRF is non-blind

finding.guards_checked: There is no scheme check, host allowlist, or private/link-local/loopback IP block. There is no DNS-resolution check and no redirect restriction. The route has no authentication. ALLOWED_HOSTS is only applied in /partner, not here.

verdict.reason: app.py:15 reads the `url` query parameter and passes it unvalidated to requests.get at app.py:16, and app.py:17 returns the status and first 500 characters of the body. The route at app.py:13 has no authentication, and the ALLOWED_HOSTS check exists only in /partner (app.py:24).
